analysis.executive_summary: Audit of docs.vendure.io covered 1383 pages with 100% crawl coverage and 91.5% overall confidence. Documentation contains 30 confirmed broken internal links requiring immediate remediation. API reference coverage is critically low at 21.95% despite 1212 API pages detected, indicating significant gaps in usage documentation. SEO/geo issues affect 31.56% of pages. Example code detection reported 0% reliability across all pages, flagged as a likely technical detection limitation due to JavaScript-rendered content.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage achieved (100%) with 1383 pages successfully indexed
High overall audit confidence at 91.5% with strong link verification (95%) and crawl confidence (95%)
Multi-project topology successfully mapped with no repository navigation link breakage
Freshness metadata present on 60.23% of pages, enabling content age tracking
Zero unverified links, indicating thorough link validation process completed
risks: 30 confirmed broken internal documentation links create poor user experience and damage credibility
API reference coverage at 21.95% leaves 78% of API surface without adequate usage documentation
SEO/geo issues on 31.56% of pages (436+ pages) harm discoverability and search rankings
Example code detection failure (0%) prevents validation of code sample accuracy and runability
Nearly 40% of pages lack freshness metadata, obscuring content staleness risk
1212 API pages detected but low coverage suggests systematic gap in tutorials, guides, or integration examples
JavaScript-rendered code blocks may hide broken examples from users and internal quality processes

prioritized_actions.action: Fix all 30 broken internal documentation links immediately
Conduct manual audit of API usage documentation to address 78% coverage gap and create remediation plan for top 20 API endpoints
Resolve SEO/geo issues on 436+ affected pages (missing meta descriptions, titles, or geo-targeting problems)
Implement server-side rendering or static generation for code examples to enable automated validation
Add last-updated metadata to remaining 40% of pages and establish content review cadence

limitations: External audit cannot verify accuracy of technical content, code correctness, or conceptual explanations
JavaScript-rendered code examples (0% detection) were not evaluated for syntax, runability, or version compatibility
API coverage metric measures reference-to-usage linking only; does not assess documentation quality, completeness, or clarity
Freshness metadata presence does not guarantee content is actually current or reflects latest product version
Audit cannot detect broken external links to third-party services, dependencies, or partner documentation
